numerical_navigation.verify_first: Check clinical mode, analysis/schema identity and manifest.files[path].sha256. Record the source bundle manifest identity. Do not infer results from remembered values or artificial data.

main_result_selection.secondary_rule: Use the corresponding primary_bmi_ge30:: IDs; do not mix references or treat this subset as independently indexed.

scale_rules.probability_and_PIF_fields: Stored as fractions: multiply by 100 when expressing percentages, including their confidence limits.
scale_rules.difference_per1000_fields: Already scaled per 1,000: do not multiply by 100 or 1,000 again.
scale_rules.pct_shifted: Already a percentage from 0 to 100; do not multiply by 100 again

guards: Scalar outcome/window filters alone may also select matched-sample checks; use exact model IDs.
PIF uses every patient in the specific model reference. BMI<=30 contributes baseline burden and zero shift difference.
Five-category Firth ICD and four-category unpenalized sensitivity have different denominators.
The joint component families have no PIFs.
Retain explicit nonestimable, failed, unavailable and sparse-support states.
Cohort population_id can identify a stage within analysis_population_id; the fields are not interchangeable.
numerical_navigation.setting_audit: N is setting × original BMI-band denominator; M usable, H positive among usable; observation=M/N with Wilson limits. n_reference is the full adjustment-complete population.

bmi_30_40_addendum.scope: Prediction-only BMI 30/40 contrasts from the exact setting-adjusted run; no refitting or primary-snapshot changes
bmi_30_40_addendum.units: Already scaled by 100: probabilities/shares are percentages, differences are percentage points; do not rescale
bmi_30_40_addendum.acidemia_fraction: Change in with-acidemia probability divided by change in joint total probability; distinct from acidemia share at one BMI and from PIF

interpretation_guardrails: Select the first valid-available-BMI index; derive secondary populations only afterward. New indexes may differ from historical obese indexes.
Primary retains any non-OBESITY pathway including OBESITY overlap. Obesity-only is flow/audit only, without an adjusted comparison or weighting analysis.
Gas curves apply to outcome-evaluable patients. Known diagnosis capture is not ICD positivity; missing or unusable evidence is not negative.
The secondary policy is observed BMI >30 minus exactly one, no floor/reselection; BMI<=30 is unchanged. PIF is conditional on the population and model.
Do not infer incidence reduction, causal weight-loss effects, untested-patient risk, or absence of selection bias. No current MAR/MNAR or IPW analysis.
Pointwise model-based intervals do not quantify selection or measurement bias; retain sparse/support warnings.
Same recorded-day co-occurrence is not verified same-sample pairing. Without documented acidemia does not establish compensation.
ICD acuity categories describe documented codes. They are not physiological acidemia categories or validation of respiratory failure.
